newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sen. D'Amato--Yellen vote could be next week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sen. D'Amato--Yellen vote could be next week.

text.p: Senate Banking Committee Chairman Alfonse D'Amato said Wednesday a full Senate vote on Janet Yellen's nomination to chair the White House Council of Economic Advisers could occur next week.
Yellen appeared before the committee at her confirmation hearing, and the committee must vote on her before the nomination is sent to the floor.
D'Amato said he expected the committee would approve her nomination.
